content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Evansville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high-school diploma with additional experience hours. Review PMI's specific education and work-hour thresholds to confirm you meet the baseline. Eligibility verification happens before application submission.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. All sessions are delivered online, allowing Evansville professionals to attend from home or office without commute. You'll work through PMI's framework and exam domains with active certified practitioners over the full course duration.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, create your PMI account and submit your formal application with your education and experience documentation. Include payment of the PMI application and exam fee. PMI will review and approve your eligibility before you can schedule your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test for the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides, to reinforce the material. Schedule your computer-based exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or via remote proctoring. You'll sit for a timed, multiple-choice exam that assesses your readiness to manage complex projects.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you'll maintain it through a three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs). Pursue PDUs through Granite PM Academy's continuing-education offerings, PMI membership, volunteer work, or other approved professional development. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your certification active.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
